## 1.3.24 (HexGhoul): Touka lives at Anteiku, Ken on top of the tower; NPCs fight to the end; the airplane spin fixed (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.24 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 63**, same as 1.3.21–1.3.23). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- **Anteiku (Touka's café)** now generates in the world, **one per world**, from the owner's build. Touka works behind the bar counter on the café floor, facing the tables. She's the only Touka in the world, and if she dies she comes back there. Find it with `/locate structure hexkagune:anteiku`.
- **The tower (Ken's)** now generates too, **one per world**: the owner's mega cyber tower. Ken stands at the very top, on the stone terrace at the foot of the spire, looking over the roof. Find it with `/locate structure hexkagune:cyber_tower`. It's about 250 blocks tall: bring an elytra, or climb.
  - The original build is 320 blocks tall, which is the entire height of a 1.20.1 world, so it can't stand on the ground as-is. Its podium and lowest floors are cut: the building starts at its first full floor above the podium, at ground level (y 62), and rises to just under the sky limit with the roof and spire intact.
  - Blocks 1.20.1 doesn't have (from 1.21) were swapped: the "iron chain" is the normal chain, tuff slabs and stairs became andesite, polished tuff became polished andesite. One trial spawner was removed.
  - Both are steered toward flat biomes (plains, savanna, desert for the tower) but allowed anywhere, so a world always gets its one Anteiku and its one tower. They only appear in newly generated land; in an existing world, explore new chunks or use `/kagune touka here` / `/kagune ken here` as before.
- **NPCs fight to the end.** Eto, Touka and Ken take on any hostile mob within **5 blocks** (it was 3) and **keep fighting until it's dead**. They only let it go if it gets more than 24 blocks away, if they'd have to chase it more than 32 blocks from home, or if they can't reach it or hit it for 30 seconds (up a cliff, behind a wall). Before, they gave up as soon as a mob stepped a few blocks from their home spot. Neutral mobs (endermen, zombified piglins, spiders by day) are left alone unless they're already attacking someone. Kids who've been taught to fight do the same with a shorter 16-block chase.
- **Fix: a human (non-ghoul) child that fought once was stuck "in a fight" forever**: no more moments, bedtime or chatter. It now goes back to normal when the fight ends.
- **Airplane spin fixed.** Your body turned the opposite way from the child flying round you. When the spin ended, everything whipped back two full turns to reset. Your body also stopped turning after one turn while the child kept going. Now you and the child turn together the same way, and it ends facing the way it started, with nothing to unwind.
